name: Adelaide Fringe

location.venue_or_area: Citywide, open-access registered venues

attendance.note: Organiser-reported tickets sold in 2026 (1,066,515 in 2025), across 1,648 shows and 562 venues. Coverage also reports more than 6 million attendances across ticketed and free events, and a record $238.3 million total expenditure. 26.4 per cent of tickets went to interstate and international visitors.

audience.psychographics: Broad open-access arts audience across comedy, cabaret, music and visual art. Mass-market in scale rather than a single scene.

ticket_price.note: Ticketed per show. For 2027 the artist-facing Inside Charge drops from 5 to 4 per cent, locked for four years. Venue registration is free.

vibe.rationale: Huge open-access festival with a real independent and alternative core, but mass-market and broad rather than a curated single community.

fit_notes: Very large adult audience over a month in Feb to Mar. Free open venue registration means a brand could run its own hub, wellness or recovery space or program strand. Breadth dilutes subculture positioning.
